source.name: IkenHuub iOS Streaming Source
source.subtitle: Official and unofficial iOS streaming app distributions.
source.description: A generic AltStore-compatible source for (un)official iOS streaming apps.

apps.name: APEX
apps.subtitle: A customized YouTube experience for iOS.
apps.localizedDescription: APEX is a customized YouTube app for iOS. This source links exclusively to the unmodified IPA published by the APEX developer in the official GitHub Release.

apps.name: YouTube by lowiqentity
apps.subtitle: A customized YouTube experience by lowiqentity.
apps.localizedDescription: A customized YouTube distribution by lowiqentity, retained alongside APEX for users who prefer this version. Future updates are not guaranteed now that the developer is also working on APEX.

apps.name: Stremio
apps.subtitle: Freedom to stream.
apps.localizedDescription: Stremio is a modern media center for movies, series, live TV, and web channels. This entry follows the unofficial omix4 AltStore source while downloading the unmodified IPA directly from Stremio's public CDN.

apps.name: Nuvio
apps.subtitle: A modern cross-platform media hub.
apps.localizedDescription: Nuvio is a modern media hub for iOS and Android with support for the Stremio addon ecosystem. This entry is published only when the official Nuvio GitHub Release provides a directly downloadable IPA.

apps.name: Nuvio Enhanced
apps.subtitle: An actively maintained enhanced Nuvio build.
apps.localizedDescription: Nuvio Enhanced is an unofficial community build of NuvioMobile with experimental features, quality-of-life improvements, and additional fixes. This source is maintained independently and links directly to the unmodified Enhanced IPA published in the NuvioMobile-iOS GitHub Releases.

apps.name: Nuvio Full
apps.subtitle: The unmodified full Nuvio community build.
apps.localizedDescription: Nuvio Full is an unofficial iOS build produced from the upstream NuvioMobile source by the NuvioMobile-iOS maintainer. This catalog links directly to the unmodified Full IPA published in that project's GitHub Releases. It shares its bundle identifier with Nuvio Enhanced, so installing one variant replaces the other.
